const text = value => typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value?._ ?? value ?? '');
const normalize = value => text(value).normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/[\u200b-\u200d\ufeff]/g,'').replace(/[-–—_/]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
const englishRules = englishTerms.map(term=>({term,pattern:new RegExp('(?:^|[^a-z0-9])'+term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&')+'(?:$|[^a-z0-9])','i')}));
return $input.all().map((input,i)=>{
  const channel = input.json.rss?.channel;
  if (!channel) throw new Error('Missing decoded RSS channel.');
  const items = !channel.item ? [] : Array.isArray(channel.item) ? channel.item : [channel.item];
  const matching = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    const title = normalize(item.title);
    const matches = [...thaiTerms.filter(term=>title.includes(normalize(term))),...englishRules.filter(rule=>rule.pattern.test(title)).map(rule=>rule.term)];
    if (matches.length) matching.push({...item,titleMatchedKeywords:[...new Set(matches)]});
  }
  // Preserve one envelope per requested stage, including stages with zero matches.
  return {json:{...input.json,rss:{...input.json.rss,channel:{...channel,item:matching}},titleFilter:{
